theme: A quiet morning, then the afternoon train south to Washington.
greeting: Early afternoon, Dan — the day's one fixed point, the 3:16 Amtrak from New York down to Washington, is coming up within the hour. The girls are with Jen this stretch.

needsAttention.title: Use the updated Amtrak eTicket
needsAttention.detail: Your 3:16 PM train to Washington is ticketed — Amtrak resent an UPDATED eTicket yesterday, so use that one, not the original.

recipe.title: Cold avocado & cucumber soup
recipe.why: A hot travel day wants no stove — a chilled avocado-cucumber soup is a cool, five-minute supper for whenever you land in DC.

acts.line: An open morning — nothing was on the calendar before the train.
Amtrak from New York down to Washington, DC (in around 6:16).
Arrive in DC — the evening is your own.
